note_en: Found while tracing OCMS14.2/14.4. Routes /embassy/special-notices/view/:notice_no and /edit/:notice_no and /embassy/draft/* exist in App.tsx, but the list entry (Epic14.SpecialNotices) and the Embassy menu are commented out, so the screens can only be opened by direct URL. feature: Cron admin fee kendaraan asing: notice PS-FOR yang belum dibayar dan melewati hari FOD sejak tanggal offence diberi administration fee dan amount_payable diperbarui (ditunda bila ada TS aktif)
note: Ditemukan saat menelusuri OCMS14.1 (step FOR). Kriteria eligibility dibaca dari AdminFeeHelper (vehicle_registration_type F, suspension PS-FOR di VON, belum dibayar, offence date + FOD hari <= hari ini). Dipanggil dari executeDayEndJobs sebagai job 5 (tidak dikomentari). Tidak ada story dalam chunk ini yang menyebut admin fee 90 hari untuk kendaraan asing; mungkin story Epic 14 lain atau story Removed (14.30-14.32) yang tidak diperiksa di chunk ini. Tiket terkait: OCMS-DF-2026-122 (Closed).
note_en: Found while tracing OCMS14.1 (FOR step). Eligibility criteria are read from AdminFeeHelper (vehicle_registration_type F, suspension PS-FOR on VON, unpaid, offence date + FOD days <= today). It is called from executeDayEndJobs as job 5 (not commented out). No story in this chunk mentions the 90-day admin fee for foreign vehicles; it may be another Epic 14 story or a Removed story (14.30-14.32) that was not checked in this chunk. Related ticket: OCMS-DF-2026-122 (Closed).

feature: TS-CLV otomatis untuk kendaraan VIP setelah surat RR3 atau DR3, ditentukan dari regex nomor kendaraan diawali V (bukan dari tabel ocms_vip_vehicle)
note: Ditemukan saat menelusuri OCMS14.1/14.5. Setelah stage RR3 atau DR3, notice dengan nomor kendaraan cocok ^V[A-Z0-9]+$ diberi TS-CLV (default 21 hari looping). Teks story 14.1 dan 14.5 tidak menyebutnya; kemungkinan dicakup story kendaraan terklasifikasi Epic 14 (14.17 ke atas) atau OCMS17 yang tidak diperiksa di chunk ini. Aturan nomor V berbeda dari isVip yang memakai tabel, sehingga bisa tidak konsisten.
note_en: Found while tracing OCMS14.1/14.5. After stage RR3 or DR3, notices whose vehicle number matches ^V[A-Z0-9]+$ get TS-CLV (default 21 days with looping). The text of stories 14.1 and 14.5 does not mention it; it is probably covered by the Epic 14 classified-vehicle stories (14.17 onwards) or OCMS17, which were not checked in this chunk. The V number rule differs from isVip, which uses the table, so they can be inconsistent.
